provenance: Measured before this repository existed, in the development repository of the first MCP release (an MCP context-measurement study, its revision 2) and its adoption study. Only numbers, versions and methods are reproduced here; the original evidence stays in that repository.
versions: release candidates of @comforge/mcp before 0.1.0 and of @comforge/cli between 0.2.0 and 0.4.0; not the current releases
tokenizer: Anthropic messages.countTokens (model claude-opus-5-5), minus an 8-token framing; per-text counts, not a model's full context
fixture: one real repository's initiative state (12 initiatives) and its GitHub data

results.what: list pull requests: MCP comforge_prs vs CLI prs --json vs raw GitHub REST JSON (gh api)
results.claim: MCP 54.0% fewer tokens than raw GitHub, 26.3% fewer than the CLI
results.why: needs live GitHub: the synthetic server returns fewer fields than github.com, which would understate the raw baseline

results.what: an issue's comments: MCP comforge_comments vs CLI comments --json vs raw GitHub REST JSON
results.claim: MCP 32.3% fewer tokens than raw GitHub

results.what: MCP first answer (summary) vs the CLI's full output
results.claim: 69–80% smaller, for an agent that needs less than everything

results.what: equivalent initiative state through MCP vs the CLI
results.claim: MCP 14–19% MORE tokens than the CLI's single JSON (envelope and split across calls)
a very small result grows by its summary marker

results.what: comforge_context over the development repository's manifest
results.claim: 15 of 15 cases routed as expected; expectations set by the implementer
results.why: that manifest is private; this repository has its own evaluation set

results.what: copy an example consumer into an empty directory, install from npm with an empty cache, run its checks
results.claim: machine time only; excludes a person reading the README and writing a configuration
